name: semantic-search
description: Embedding-based semantic code search. Indexes code chunks (AST-aware for Python) into a local sqlite vector store, queries them with natural language. Embeddings via $LLM_BASE_URL /v1/embeddings (LM Studio or OpenAI-compatible).
use_when: asking 'where is X handled' semantically instead of grepping

args.name: index <path>
args.description: Build or incrementally update the code index for a directory.

args.name: query <text> [--k 8] [--path substr]
args.description: Top-k code chunks matching the natural-language query.

args.name: stats
args.description: Index size: files, chunks, db path/bytes.

env.AGENT_EMBED_MODEL: Embedding model id; auto-detected from /v1/models when unset.

stdout: JSON {results: [{path, start_line, end_line, score, snippet}]} or index/stats info.
